subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"for"** is used to indicate the purpose or reason for something. (के लिए)

 
 
• **Example: **This gift is** for **you.
 
 
 
• Here in this context the last line of the paragraph requires a preposition of time that actually states a duration. So,** 'for'** is perfect fit here.
 
• Hence the correct statement should be ''***Superheroes have been a staple of popular culture 'for'__ decades, appearing in comics, movies, television shows, and video games.'' ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Other given prepositions are incorrect in this context.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **On** (पर): Indicates a position above and in contact with a surface.

 
 
• **Example:** The vase is **on **the shelf.
 
 
 
• **Under** (के नीचे): Indicates a position directly below something.
 
 
• **Example:** The cat is** under **the table.
 
 
 
• **Above** (ऊपर): Indicates a position higher than something else.
 
 
• **Example:** The picture is** above** the fireplace.
